route.title: Abigale
steps: Talk to Abigale in the south-east corner of Lumbridge Swamp. Dialogue: “Yes”.

route.title: Enter the manor
steps: Board the rowboat south of Abigale; it takes you to the manor.
Pick up the bucket near the fountain.
Search the barrel of rainwater north of the fountain to trigger a cutscene.
Use the bucket on the barrel of rainwater.
Search the barrel again: the manor key is at the bottom.
Enter the manor.

route.title: Puzzle 1
steps: Take the knife from the table.
Try to open the door with the pink handle.
Pick up the note that appeared.
Read the note.
Use the knife on the marked painting.
Search the painting for the ruby key.
Go through the door with the ruby handle.

route.title: Puzzle 2
steps: Search the shelves for a tinderbox.
Light all the unlit candles in the room.
Light the fuse on the barrel of gunpowder.
Leave the room to trigger the explosion.
Climb over the damaged wall.

route.title: Puzzle 3
steps: Observe Lacey through the trees.
Pick up the note by the fence.
Read the note.
Search the piano (right-click Search) for the emerald key. The tune is D-E-A-D.

route.title: Another murder
steps: Climb back over the damaged wall into the manor.
Go through the door with the green handle.
Try to enter the room containing the Bandos godsword; another murder takes place.

route.title: Puzzle 4
steps: Pick up the note by the door.
Read the note.
Use the knife on the unlit fireplace in the eastern room.
Search the fireplace and enter the stones in order: Sapphire, Diamond, Zenyte, Emerald, Onyx, Ruby.
Search the fireplace again for the sapphire key.

route.title: The murderer
steps: Go through the door with the sapphire handle.
Move the mirror to reflect the knives the murderer throws; a black swirl surrounds the wardrobe he throws from.
Watch the killer's reveal cutscene.
Pick up the killer's knife.
Equip the killer's knife, then select Fight on Abigale (no actual combat occurs).
Attempt to go through the sapphire door.
Talk to Mandy just outside the manor to complete the quest.

steps: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington. Dialogue: “I am in search of a quest” → “Yes”.

route.title: Ingredients
steps: Kill a rat in the house to the west for a rat's tail. The tail only drops after you start the quest.

Pick an onion in the field north of Rimmington.

route.title: Brew the potion
steps: Bring all four ingredients to Hetty.
Drink from the cauldron in Hetty's house to finish the quest.

steps: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador Castle. Dialogue: “And how is life as a squire?” → “I can make a new sword if you like” → “So would these dwarves make another one?” → “Yes”.
Talk to Reldo in the library of Varrock Palace. Dialogue: “What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?”.

route.title: Find the Imcando dwarf
steps: Talk to Thurgo south of Port Sarim and give him a redberry pie. Dialogue: “Would you like a redberry pie?”.
Talk to Thurgo again. Dialogue: “Can you make a special sword for me?”.

route.title: Find the portrait
steps: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador Castle.
Climb up the east ladder in Falador Castle.
Go up the staircase west of the ladder on the first floor.
Search the cupboard in the room south of the staircase. Sir Vyvin must be in the other room, or he will notice you.
Bring Thurgo the portrait. Dialogue: “About that sword”.

route.title: Forge the sword
steps: Go down the ladder south of Port Sarim into the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. Ice giants and ice warriors attack here, so keep away from them.
Mine a blurite ore in the eastern cavern.
Return to Thurgo with a blurite ore and two iron bars. Dialogue: “Can you make that replacement sword now?”.

route.title: Return the sword
steps: Return to the Squire with the sword to finish the quest.

route.title: Talk to Redbeard Frank
steps: Talk to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim. Dialogue: “I'm in search of treasure” → “Yes”.

route.title: Smuggle rum
steps: Talk to one of the Seamen on the docks in Port Sarim to sail to Musa Point (30 gp). Dialogue: “Yes please”.
Talk to Zembo in the Karamja Wines, Spirits and Beers bar and buy one Karamjan rum (30 gp). Dialogue: “Yes please”.
Pick 10 bananas nearby, then talk to Luthas about working for him. Dialogue: “Could you offer me employment on your plantation?” → “Will you pay me for another crate full?”.
Put the Karamjan rum into the crate.
Fill the rest of the crate with bananas (right-click Fill), then talk to Luthas.
Talk to Luthas and tell him you finished filling the crate.

route.title: Back to Port Sarim
steps: Head back to Port Sarim and pay the Customs officer to sail there (30 gp). Dialogue: “Thank you, I'll be on my way” → “Can I journey on this ship?” → “Search away, I have nothing to hide” → “Ok” → “Search away. I have nothing to hide” → “Okay”.
Grab the white apron from the Port Sarim Fishing Shop (it hangs on the back wall).
Wear the apron and ask Wydin for a job in the Port Sarim food shop, then search the crate in the back room for the rum. Dialogue: “Well, can I get a job here?”.
Bring the Karamjan rum to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim; he gives you a key.

route.title: Find the treasure

Open the chest on the first floor with the key and take the Pirate message. Dialogue: “Ok thanks, I'll go and get it”.
Read the Pirate message.
Dig in the middle of the cross in Falador Park, and kill the Gardener (level 4) who appears. Once killed, dig again.

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace. Dialogue: “Is there anything I can help you with?” → “Yes”.
Talk to Osman north of the Al Kharid Palace.

route.title: Blonde wig
steps: Have Ned in Draynor Village make you a wig from 3 balls of wool. He also sells rope: 15 coins via dialogue, 18 coins from his shop, or 4 balls of wool. Dialogue: “Could you make other things apart from rope?” → “How about some sort of wig?” → “I have them here. Please make me a wig”.
Dye the wig with yellow dye. If you need a yellow dye, Aggie in Draynor Village makes one from two onions and 5 coins.

route.title: Skin paste
steps: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village to get some paste. She needs ashes, redberries, a pot of flour and a bucket of water. Dialogue: “Can you make skin paste?” → “Yes please. Mix me some skin paste”.

route.title: Key print
steps: Talk to Lady Keli in the jail east of Draynor Village and take a print of the key: use soft clay on the key. If you have already made the print, open the quest journal to re-sync. Dialogue: “Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!” → “What's your latest plan then?” → “How do you know someone won't try to free him?” → “Could I see the key please?” → “Could I touch the key for a moment please?”.

route.title: The key
steps: Use the key print on any furnace with a bronze bar in your inventory to make a bronze key (the nearest furnace is in Lumbridge).

route.title: Bring everything to Leela
steps: Talk to Leela east of Draynor Village.

route.title: Free Ali
steps: The level 26 jail guards inside the jail attack on sight and hit up to 3: walk past them, the quest does not need them dead.
Bring everything to the jail and give Joe three beers. Dialogue: “I have some beer here. Fancy one?”.
Use the rope on Lady Keli to tie her up.
Use the key on the prison door. If Lady Keli respawned you will need to tie her up again.
Talk to Prince Ali and free him (wear the wig, skirt and paste).

route.title: Return to Al Kharid
steps: Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace to complete the quest.

The second goblin mail is in a crate in the western hut.
The third goblin mail is in a crate north of the generals' hut.

Repeat until the Ancient Guardian is defeated. If it hurts you faster than you mine, use the safespot: lure it to the east side and retreat into the entrance passage.

route.title: Choose a gang
steps: You and a partner join different gangs: one the Phoenix Gang, the other the Black Arm Gang. You cannot change later. The chat channel “OSRS SOA” finds a partner.

route.title: Phoenix Gang
steps: Talk to Baraek in Varrock Square: ask about the Phoenix Gang, not furs. Dialogue: “Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?” → “Okay. Have 20 gold coins.”.
Climb down the ladder into the Phoenix Gang hideout in south-east Varrock and talk to Straven. Dialogue: “I know who you are!” → “I'd like to offer you my services.”.
Kill Jonny the Beard (level 2) in the Blue Moon Inn and pick up the Intel report.
Give the Intel report to Straven in the hideout: he gives you the Weapon store key.
Search the chest in the hideout for half of the Shield of Arrav.

route.title: Black Arm Gang
steps: Talk to Charlie the Tramp at the south entrance of Varrock. Dialogue: “Is there anything down this alleyway?” → “I'm looking for the Black Arm Gang.” → “Do you think they would let me join?”.
Talk to Katrine down the alley to the west and join her gang. Dialogue: “I want to become a member of your gang.” → “Well, you can give me a try can't you?” → “Ok, no problem.”.
Get the Weapon store key from your Phoenix Gang partner, climb the ladder into the weapon storeroom in south-east Varrock, kill the Weaponsmaster (level 23) and pick up both Phoenix crossbows.
Bring both crossbows to Katrine, go up the stairs in the gang base and search the cupboard for half of the Shield of Arrav.

route.title: Finish together
steps: Pass the Weapon store key to your partner, then take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum: he gives you half of a certificate.
Swap certificate halves with a player of the other gang (a partner or a second account; alone, skip the quest: it is optional) and use the two halves together.
Give the Certificate to King Roald in Varrock Palace to finish the quest.

steps: Talk to Captain Tock north of Port Sarim. Dialogue: “What kind of help do you need?” → “Sure, I'll try to help with your curse”.

route.title: Investigate the curse
steps: Talk to Ithoi in the south-western hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.
Talk to Gnocci in the north-west hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.
Talk to Arsen in the central hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.
Talk to Colin in the central hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.

Take the spade in the south of Corsair Cove.

Talk to Chief Tess in the Corsair Cove Dungeon and return the relic. Dialogue: “I've come to return what Arsen stole”.
Dig next to the tree south-west of the cove to find the doll. Dialogue: “Search for the possessed doll and face the consequences”.
Go look through Ithoi's telescope.
Talk to Gnocci again in the north-west hut.
Talk to Arsen again in the central hut.
Talk to Colin again in the central hut.

route.title: Expose the traitor
steps: Talk to Captain Tock on the ship. Dialogue: “I've ruled out all the Corsairs' theories” → “So what do I do now?”.
Talk to Gnocci in the north-west hut. Dialogue: “I hear it happened straight after dinner”.
Talk to Arsen in the central hut. Dialogue: “I hear Ithoi cooked the meal you ate that night”.

Talk to Ithoi and confront him: he is not actually sick. Dialogue: “I bet I can prove you're well enough to get up” → “I know you've faked the curse” → “I hear you cooked the meal they ate before getting sick” → “Maybe because the Captain's thinking of firing you”.
Use your tinderbox on the driftwood under Ithoi's hut.
Talk to Captain Tock on the ship. Dialogue: “I've seen Ithoi running around. He's not sick at all”.

route.title: Deal with Ithoi
steps: Kill Ithoi (level 35). Fight him with melee or magic, and eat when your health is below 15.
Talk to Captain Tock on the ship to finish the quest. Dialogue: “I've killed Ithoi for poisoning your crew”.

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree (make sure to have two empty inventory slots to start the quest). Dialogue: “You seem worried, what's up?” → “I'd be happy to help!”.

route.title: Hazelmere
steps: Go up to Hazelmere, on the island east of Yanille: on foot from Yanille (the fairy ring CLS opens only after Fairytale II, step S9-03).
Talk to Hazelmere; he takes the bark sample and gives you a message for the king.

route.title: Investigation
steps: Return to King Narnode in the Grand Tree and pass on the message. Dialogue: “I think so!” → “A man came to me with the King's seal” → “I gave the man Daconia rocks” → “And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!”.
Go up to Glough in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Talk to Glough.
Talk to King Narnode again in the Grand Tree.
Talk to Charlie on the top floor of the Grand Tree.
Return to Charlie.
Return to Glough's house and search the cupboard for Glough's journal.
Talk to Glough about his journal; you get arrested.
Talk to Charlie in the cell.
Talk to King Narnode outside Charlie's cell.
Travel with the glider (at the top of the tree) to Karamja to escape. Dialogue: “Take me to Karamja please!”.

route.title: Karamja
steps: Enter the shipyard on Karamja: say Glough sent you and give the password Ka-Lu-Min. Dialogue: “Glough sent me” → “Ka” → “Lu” → “Min”.

Get the lumber order from the Foreman on the southern docks. You can either kill him or talk to him (answer the security questions). Dialogue: “Sadly his wife is no longer with us!” → “He loves worm holes” → “Anita”.

route.title: Tuzo
steps: Talk to Anita in the house west of the Grand Tree; she gives you a key.
Search the chest in Glough's house with the key and take the invasion plans (finish the dialogue).
Take the invasion plans to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.
Place the twigs to spell 'TUZO' in the watchtower in Glough's house. Return to King Narnode if you lost any. If your Agility is below 25, eat a summer pie.

route.title: The black demon
steps: Go down the trapdoor. Be prepared for the fight against a Black demon (level 172).
Kill the black demon. Stand just north of the stairs and the demon gets stuck behind the rocks; use magic, ranged or a halberd for up to 10 minutes.
Talk to King Narnode deeper in the cave (finish the dialogue).
Search the roots under the Grand Tree until you find the last daconia rock. If you lose the rock, it will be in the same root again.
Give the daconia rock to King Narnode under the Grand Tree to finish the quest.

route.title: Starting the quest
steps: Speak to Edmond. Dialogue: "What's happened to her?", "Yes."
Speak to Alrena inside or near the house.
Take the Picture of Elena off the table in the house.
Speak to Edmond.
Use 4 buckets of water on the mud patch behind the house (between the cabbages and potatoes).
Dig with a spade on the softened ground.
Go south to the farthest pipe.
Attempt to open the grill.
Use a rope on the grill.
Speak to Edmond.
Put on the gas mask and climb up the pipe.

route.title: Finding Elena
steps: Go east and speak to Jethick; he will give you a book. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll return it for you."
Go north to the house against the wall (next to the rotten apple spawn).
Attempt to open the door.
Speak to Martha Rehnison or Ted Rehnison in the house.
Go upstairs and speak to Milli Rehnison.
Go south of the town square to the large building along the southern wall with an "X" on the doors and a staircase inside going down. Attempt to open the door. Dialogue: "I fear not a mere plague."

route.title: Getting inside
steps: Go to the large main building on the north side of the town square, north of the manhole.
Talk to the Clerk in the main room. Dialogue: "Who is through that door?", "This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!"
Speak to Bravek. Dialogue: "This is really important though!", "Do you know what's in the cure?"
:He will give you a scruffy note for a hangover cure.
Use the hangover cure on Bravek; he will give you a warrant. Dialogue: "They won't listen to me!"

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Return to the Mourner house, the one with "X" on the doors and the stairwell.
Search the barrel west of the staircase for a small key.
Go downstairs, enter the cell, and speak to Elena.
Return to the town square, go down the manhole, through the sewer, climb the mud pile, and speak to Edmond at his house.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Trufitus in his house located north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai. Dialogue: "It's a nice village, where is everyone?", "Me? How can I help?", "It sounds like just the challenge for me." route.title: =Snake weed=
steps: Go south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai until green and yellow vines labelled 'marshy jungle vine' are seen.
Search the vines and clean the herb. Your character may spend several minutes finding a herb.
Talk to Trufitus. Make sure you cleaned the herb. Dialogue: "Of course!"

route.title: =Ardrigal=
steps: Head north-east from Trufitus. There will be Harpie Bug Swarms and palm trees.
Search the palm trees and clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus. Dialogue: "Of course!"

route.title: =Sito foil=
steps: To the direct south of Tai Bwo Wannai Village is a patch of scorched earth.
Search the scorched earth (the squares immediately next to the fire) for the herb and clean it.
Talk to Trufitus. Dialogue: "Of course!"

route.title: =Volencia moss=
steps: Go south-east from Trufitus until you reach the Karamja Jungle mine, marked with a File:Mining site icon.png pickaxe on minimap.

Talk to Trufitus. Dialogue: "Of course!"

route.title: =Rogue's purse=
steps: Go back by the Harpie Bug Swarms and head north-west until a cave is seen over the cavern. Search the rocks and enter the cave.

In the cave, head south, look for green spots on the wall labelled 'Fungus covered Cavern wall', then search them and clean the herb. This process may take up to a minute. Do not try to use a Rogue's purse dropped by a Jogre. It <u>must</u> be obtained via searching the wall.
Talk to Trufitus. Dialogue: "Of course!"
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Fixing the Observatory
steps: Speak with the Observatory professor. Dialogue: "Talk about the Observatory quest.", "An Observatory?", "Sounds interesting. How can I help?"
Give the Observatory professor the three planks, bronze bar and molten glass (speak to him 3 separate times Dialogue: "Talk about the Observatory quest." each time).
Speak to the assistant.
Go up the east hill and down the stairs.

Once downstairs, search all the chests until you find the goblin kitchen key (most commonly found in south-eastern part when you go down the stairs, don't skip the dialogue once you find the key or you will not pick it up. If not found in the two chests directly south-east from the stairs, it is guaranteed to be in the last chest in the dungeon. The other chests will contain poisonous spiders.).
Head north from the entrance in the dungeon, then go west to the kitchen gate and prod the sleeping guard, then kill or trap him.
Open the gate and inspect the goblin stove.
Go back and speak to the professor with the lens mould in your inventory. Dialogue: "Talk about the Observatory quest." He will give back the needed molten glass for the next part.
Use the molten glass on the lens mould.
Speak to the professor to give him the lens mould and the observatory lens. Dialogue: "Talk about the Observatory quest."
Head back into the goblin dungeon.
Run past the kitchen and climb up the stairs in the south end of the dungeon. (During the cutscene, DO NOT CLICK on anything in the observatory or you'll have to restart the cutscene)

route.title: Finishing up
steps: After the cutscene, talk to the professor upstairs and view the telescope. Dialogue: "Talk about the Observatory quest."
Talk to the professor again and identify the constellation you saw (see table below). Dialogue: "Talk about the Observatory quest."
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to King Arthur. Dialogue: "I want to become a knight of the round table!"
Talk to Sir Gawain, who can be found in the courtyard to the south or nearby in the castle. Dialogue: "Do you know how Merlin got trapped?"
Talk to Sir Lancelot upstairs. Dialogue: "Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?"
Go to Catherby.
Prepare for combat against Sir Mordred.
Hide in the crate east of the candle maker's shop. Dialogue: "Yes" Wait and finish the cutscene. Climb out of the crate. Dialogue: "Yes"

route.title: Inside the keep
steps: Climb to the top floor. The Renegade Knights will attack you on your way up.

Attack Sir Mordred. He cannot be safespotted, but he can be flinched using the stairs (position him on the square left of the stairs whilst flinching from the square north-east of him). He can also be killed with rings of recoil or by another account poisoning and attacking right before his death.

When Sir Mordred reaches 0 hitpoints, Morgan Le Faye will appear and ask that you spare him. Spare his life to discover how to save Merlin. Dialogue: "Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.", "OK I will do all that." Do not interrupt the dialogue or you will have to fight Sir Mordred again.

route.title: Black candle
steps: Talk to the candle-maker in Catherby. Dialogue: "Have you got any black candles?"
Talk to him again for a black candle.

route.title: Excalibur
steps: Talk to The Lady of the Lake south-east of Taverley on the peninsula. Dialogue: "I seek the sword Excalibur."
Go to Port Sarim. (Make sure you have bread in your inventory.)
Enter the jewellery shop to the north.
Give the beggar your bread. Dialogue: "Yes certainly." Finish the conversation.

route.title: Ritual
steps: Go to the Zamorakian temple in the south-east corner of Varrock.
Check the Chaos Altar's inscription.
Return to Camelot with a tinderbox and enter the castle gates.
Go to the ritual site at the north-east corner of the Camelot castle grounds (a red star in the middle of 8 columns).
Stand on the star and light the black candle.
Drop the bat bones on the star.
The magic words are "Snarthon Candtrick Termanto".

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Enter the castle and climb to the top of the south-east tower.
Smash the giant crystal with Excalibur. (Does not require 20 Attack, just use Excalibur on the crystal instead of attempting to wield it)
Talk to King Arthur.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Go to the Exam Centre.
Ask an examiner about an exam. Dialogue: "Can I take an exam?"
Go to the Varrock museum and talk to Curator Haig Halen. He will give you a Sealed letter. Dialogue: "Have you any interesting news?"
Go back to the Exam Centre and talk to an examiner. The chat options do not matter; you will fail the exam regardless.

route.title: Lost and found
steps: North of the exam centre at the hilltop with the blue urn, search the second bush to the east of the blue urn to find a teddy bear.
Take the panning tray.
Use the cup of tea on the nearby panning guide.
Pan the water at the panning points until you find a Special cup (browse through dialogue if stopped – referred to as "Shiny Cup" in dialogue). If you need an opal continue panning until you get one.
Steal from the workman near the panning points until you get an animal skull and specimen brush.
Run north to the female student with blonde hair and pigtails on the north-west end of the dig and give her the "teddy" by talking to her twice.
Run east to the student with a beard and a reddish-orange shirt and give him the Special cup by talking to him twice.
Run south to the student in a green shirt and give him the Animal skull by talking to him twice.

route.title: Exams
steps: Return to an examiner. Dialogue: "Yes, I certainly am.", "The study of the earth, its contents and history.", "All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.", "Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used." – You should receive 'Level 1 Certificate'
Talk to all 3 students again.

Return to an examiner to take the second exam. Dialogue: "I am ready for the next exam.", "Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.", "Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.", "Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point." – You should receive 'Level 2 Certificate'
Talk to all 3 students – the female student will demand an opal (can be obtained by panning). Talk to her two times.

Return to an examiner for the final exam. Dialogue: "I am ready for the last exam...", "Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.", "Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.", "Handle bones very carefully and keep them amay from other samples." – You should receive 'Level 3 Certificate'

route.title: Helping the expert
steps: Back at the Exam Centre, go in the western room and search the cupboards on the north and south walls to get a rock pick and a specimen jar, respectively.
If you haven't already, steal a specimen brush from the Digsite workman.
Use the trowel on the soil in either level 3 digsite until you obtain an ancient talisman. Note: This step can take several minutes depending upon luck.
Talk to Terry Balando in the exam centre.
Use the invitation on any Digsite workman except the one by the western winch.
Use a rope on the western winch, then climb down.
Pick up one of the arcenia root in the room, search the bricks to the east, then climb back up.
Walk north-east to the northern winch, use the rope on the winch, and climb down.
Talk to Doug Deeping about the rocks. Dialogue: "How could I move a large pile of rocks?" Climb up the rope.

route.title: Explosives expert
steps: Walk to the tent to the south (marked with the orange vial), unlock the chest with the Chest Key and search to obtain chemical powder.
Use the trowel on the closed barrel to the west of the tent.
Use a vial on the barrel to get an unidentified liquid. If dropped, it will deal 25 non-fatal damage, and destroy the vial requiring you to re-open the barrel and collect more.
Grind the charcoal with your pestle and mortar.
Return to the exam centre and use the chemical powder and the unidentified liquid on Terry Balando (Note: make sure you right-click the liquid otherwise you'll empty it).
Mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together to create mixed chemicals, then add ground charcoal and finally arcenia root to produce chemical compound.
Climb down the western winch.
Use the compound on the bricks (not the rocks).
Use your tinderbox on the bricks.
Enter the large chamber, take the stone tablet. Low-levels should be wary of Level 22 skeletons.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Use the tablet on Terry Balando.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to King Arthur. Dialogue: "Tell me of this quest.", "I'd enjoy trying that."

route.title: Searching for the Holy Grail
steps: Bank all weapons and armour. Travel to Entrana.
Talk to the High Priest in the chapel. Dialogue: "Ok, I will go searching."
Travel to Galahad's house west of McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring code ) or combat bracelet to Ranging Guild.
Talk to Galahad and receive the holy table napkin. Dialogue: "I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King."
Travel to Draynor Manor's southern-most room with the holy table napkin in your inventory and pick up 2 magic whistles from the table. The whistles will not be visible until you enter the room.

route.title: The Fisher Realm
steps: Prepare for the fight against the Black Knight Titan.
Travel north-west of Brimhaven to the north-western peninsula (see the minimap image).
Stand under the tower and blow a magic whistle to be teleported to the Fisher Realm.
Fight the Black Knight Titan nearby on the bridge and kill the titan with Excalibur. See the in-depth quest guide for details.
Head south along the river and talk to the fisherman. Dialogue: "Any ideas how to get into the castle?"

Head to the castle, south-west of the fisherman, pick up the Grail bell from the ground and ring it. (You must stand in front of the bricks to gain access to the castle. Make sure NOT to use the Magic Whistle or you will be teleported outside and you will have to fight the Black Knight Titan again.)

Take the stairs to the south, and talk to the Fisher King. Dialogue: "I seek the Holy Grail.", "You don't look too well." (Make sure to talk to him about both options or you will have to kill the Black Knight Titan again if you leave.)

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Travel to Camelot and talk to King Arthur. Make sure to have 1 empty slot in your inventory for Magic gold feather he gives you.
Travel to Goblin Village.
Use the Open option on the sacks in the house in the east side of Goblin Village.
Talk to Sir Percival, he will take your magic whistle. Make sure you have another to get to the Fisher Realm yourself. Dialogue: "Come with me, I shall make you a king."
Travel back to the Fisher Realm (via Brimhaven or using the fairy ring code . You do not need to fight the Titan again either way)
Head to the top floor of the castle's eastern tower and take the Holy grail.
Return to King Arthur.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Start the quest by reading the signpost in the centre of Canifis or by talking to Dr Fenkenstrain.
Take a pickled brain off the table in the tavern in Canifis for 50gp, or by using Telekinetic Grab.
Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain inside of Fenkenstrain's Castle. Dialogue: "Yes.", "Braindead", "Grave-digging"
Go upstairs by the eastern or western staircase to the bookcases and read:
Right-click dig at the cross-shaped grave marker in the Haunted Woods, south-east of Fenkenstrain's castle and immediately east of fairy ring .
Combine the decapicated head and the pickled brain.
Head north out of the Haunted Woods and use your star amulet on the easternmost memorial (south-east of Fenkenstrain's castle).
Push the memorial to enter the Experiment Cave.
Inside, kill a level 51 Experiment for the cavern key. If you have started Rag and Bone Man II, kill additional Experiments (level 25) for the Experiment bone.
Follow the north-western path to the end.
Search the chest and climb the ladder.
Right-click Dig at the three graves to get the torso, arms and legs.
Return to Dr Fenkenstrain (Fenkenstrain's castle teleport) and give him the body parts. Dialogue: "I have some body parts for you."
Talk to him again to give him the needle and thread.
Talk to the Gardener Ghost for the shed key (ensure ghostspeak amulet is equipped). Dialogue: "Do you know where the key to the shed is?"
Search the cupboard inside the shed to get a garden brush.
Take 3 canes from the pile of canes next to the shed
Use all the canes (3) on the garden brush to get an extended brush (using a total of 3 bronze wires).
Go upstairs to the western fireplace and use the extended brush on the fireplace for a conductor mould.
Go to a furnace (closest is in Port Phasmatys, teleport to Falador, fairy ring to Zanaris, amulet of glory to Al Kharid) and smelt a silver bar into a conductor (lightning rod).
Return to the castle, go upstairs and then climb the southern ladder to reach the lightning conductor.
Repair the lightning conductor.
Return to Dr Fenkenstrain and talk to him.
Go upstairs, then through the metal door, then climb the northern ladder.
Talk to Fenkenstrain's monster.
Go downstairs, then pickpocket the doctor for the Ring of Charos.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Start
steps: Enter the ruined house in the south-west of Mort'ton. Search the shelf on the wall. Read the diary. After reading the diary, the quest is started and you are able to create Serum 207.
If you didn't bring Tarromin potion (unf): Pick up the empty vials (can be filled in the house north-east) and search the smashed table for 2 grimy tarromin and one grimy rogue's purse.

route.title: Serum 207
steps: Make two Serum 207 by adding clean tarromin to a vial of water and then adding ashes.

Use one dose on Razmire (afflicted) in the general store. Dialogue: "What are all these shadowy creatures?", "Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures." (Recommended to not use official Mort'ton temple World 377 yet to not get interrupted talking to the NPCs, until the step with repairing.)
Kill five loar shades and pick up their remains. Note: any shades that you killed before talking to Razmire will not count.
Return to Razmire and give him the remains. He may require more Serum 207.
Right click and open his General store, buy an Olive oil.
Open his builders' store, buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, 25 swamp paste and optionally a Flamtaer hammer.
Use the serum on Ulsquire Shauncy, located in the house east of the general store. Talk to him with Loar Remains.
Talk to him again and ask about the remains and the temple. Dialogue: "What did you find out about the remains?", "What can you tell me about that temple?"

route.title: Repairing the temple
steps: Head north-east of Mort'ton and repair the temple until you reach 100% repair and at least 20 sanctity. (Recommended to use official world 377.)
Light the sacred altar in the centre of the temple (or wait until someone else lights it if you don't have level 5 Firemaking)
Use your olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil.
(Recommended) Use Serum 207 on the flame to make Serum 208, which permanently cures NPCs.

route.title: Burning a shade
steps: Use the sacred oil on a log to create a pyre log.
Head west of Mort'ton general store, to any grouping of 4 stone funeral pyres. Use the pyre log, then Loar remains on a funeral pyre.
Light the funeral pyre. Note: This will grant 25 Prayer XP.
Collect the reward.
(Recommended) Use the Serum 208 on Razmire.
Use the Serum 208 on Ulsquire and finish the dialogue.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to Vanstrom Klause in the Canifis pub (near the staircase). Dialogue: "Why do they need help? Are they in trouble?", "Perhaps I could help you out here."
Grab the 6 wooden planks, 10 coins, a hammer, all the steel weapons and nails, and fill your Druid Pouch if you haven't done so already before teleporting!
Travel to Mort'ton (Mort'ton teleport, Minigame teleport to Shades of Mort'ton, Barrows teleport, with 50 Agility, and get Swamp Boaty, or run from Canifis)

Talk to Cyreg Paddlehorn (east, by the boat). Dialogue: "Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons.", "Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons?", "If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head!", "What kind of man are you to say that you don't care?", "Give wooden planks to Cyreg"
Board the boat. (Be sure to have filled your Druid Pouch before attempting to board the boat!)
Go north and climb the tree rope bridge.
Repair the bridge.
Continue north and talk to Curpile Fyod. Dialogue: "I've come to help the Myreque, I've brought weapons."
Go north and enter the wooden doors set into the hill.
Head north-west following the eastern wall to the north west until you find an alcove. Enter the cave entrance in the southern wall of this alcove.
Talk to Veliaf (no chat options needed).
Talk to everyone else (no chat options needed).
Talk to Veliaf (talk to him and give him your steel weapons).

Kill the level 97 Skeleton Hellhound (you can safespot the hellhound by luring it to the north-east side of the room, to the right of the north barrel or below the north-east bed shown in the picture on the right).
Talk to Veliaf, ask how to get out. Dialogue: "How do I get out of here?", "Ok, thanks."
Go back by entering the cave entrance and search the wall to the north.
Climb up the ladder in the north side of the room.
Talk to the Stranger in the Canifis pub (the one sitting in the chair where Vanstrom Klause was).
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to the Warrior south-east of Draynor Village. Dialogue: “What are you camped out here for?” → “What makes you think it's out here?” → “If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?” → “Looks like you don't know either” → “Yes”.

route.title: Find Shamus
steps: Try cutting the tree just to the west; a leprechaun appears. Dialogue: “I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city”.
Talk to Shamus. Dialogue: “I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city”.

route.title: Dramen branch
steps: Bank all weapons and armour you have (including the axe), go to Port Sarim and take the boat to Entrana.
Climb down the ladder on the north side of the island. Once you go down, you can only escape via teleport. Dialogue: “Well that is a risk I will have to take”.
Kill the zombies (level 25) with Fire Strike until one drops a bronze axe.
Run past the greater demons to the south and chop the Dramen tree from its south side: a Tree Spirit (level 101) appears.
Kill the Tree Spirit with Fire Strike from between the mushrooms to the south-west.
Cut at least one branch from the Dramen tree. It's recommended you cut at least 4 branches so you don't have to return in future quests.
Teleport away with the branches, preferably to Lumbridge.

route.title: Enter Zanaris
steps: Use a knife on the Dramen branch to craft a Dramen staff.
Enter the shed south of Lumbridge with your Dramen staff equipped; this is the entrance to Zanaris.

Use the enchanted bar on the wall of flame.

Go to the north-west of the island and talk to the monkey child there a few times. Eventually you'll give him 5 bananas, and he'll give you a monkey talisman. Dialogue: “Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!” → “How many bananas did Aunty want?” → “Ok, I promise!” → “I've lost that toy you gave me” → “Wow - can I borrow it?”.
Talk to the monkey child again.
Talk to the monkey child again.
Give the monkey child 5 bananas.
Wait for the aunt to make another round, then talk to the monkey child for the talisman.

Kill a zombie monkey for its bones.

WALK/RUN to Daero to return to Ape Atoll. If you teleport, you'll have to start again.
Talk to Garkor.
Talk to a guard outside the building in the south-east of Marim. If you already have, open the quest journal to re-sync.
Talk to Kruk in the north-west of the island.
Talk to Awowogei twice.
Talk to Garkor.

Kill the Jungle Demon with Ranged: stand still at the start, Protect from Magic, stay three or more squares away, and land the last hit yourself.
Return to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold to finish the quest.

route.title: The Guildmaster's questions
steps: Return to the Guildmaster and ask every question in turn: the ship, the shield, Melzar's, Thalzar's and Lozar's map pieces. Asking about Melzar's piece gives you the Maze key.

do.t: Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild, south of Varrock. Dialogue: “Can I have a quest?”. You need 32 quest points.
do.s: Guildmaster (Champions' Guild): ask for a quest (32 QP)

do.t: Talk to Oziach in his hut in north-western Edgeville. Dialogue: “Can you sell me a rune platebody?” → “The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.” → “I thought you were going to give me a quest.” → “A dragon, that sounds like fun.”.
do.s: Oziach (Edgeville): ask about the dragon quest

do.t: Return to the Guildmaster and ask every question in turn. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “Where can I find the right ship?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask where to find the right ship

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster again. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I protect myself from the dragon's breath?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask how to survive the dragon's breath

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster again. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I find the route to Crandor?” → “Where is Melzar's map piece?”. He gives you the Maze key.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask about Melzar's map piece (gives the Maze key)

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster again. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I find the route to Crandor?” → “Where is Thalzar's map piece?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask about Thalzar's map piece

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster once more. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I find the route to Crandor?” → “Where is Lozar's map piece?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask about Lozar's map piece

route.title: Ground floor: the red key
steps: Enter Melzar's Maze north of Rimmington with the Maze key. Each coloured key opens one door and then crumbles, a wrong door too.
Kill the marked zombie rat for the red Key, open the red door with the floor tile (west wall, north end), then climb the ladder.

route.title: First floor: the orange key
steps: Kill the marked ghost for the orange Key, open the orange door with the floor tile (east wall, second from the north), then climb the ladder.

route.title: Second floor: the yellow key
steps: Kill the marked skeleton for the yellow Key, open the yellow door with the floor tile (south wall, furthest west), then take the ladders down to the basement.

route.title: Basement: blue, magenta and green keys
steps: Kill the marked zombie (blue key), Melzar the Mad (magenta key) and the lesser demon (green key), open the doors and the chest for the map piece.

do.t: Open Melzar's Maze (north of Rimmington) with the Maze key. One right door per floor, marked by a floor tile; a key crumbles in any door it opens. Bring Water, Air and Mind runes: the basement demon is a magic fight.
do.s: Melzar's Maze: open the door (Maze key)

pre.t: Runes for the lesser demon: it is a magic fight

do.t: In the room with the rats, kill the zombie rat the guide marks (level 3, long tail): it drops the red Key.
do.s: Rat room: kill the marked zombie rat (red Key)

do.t: Open the red door with the guide's floor tile: on the room's west wall, at its north end. The other red doors are dead ends and use up the key. "The door is locked" means you have no red Key: kill the marked rat again.
do.s: Rat room: the red door with the floor tile

do.t: Climb the ladder just behind the red door up to the first floor.
do.s: Behind the red door: ladder up

do.t: On the first floor, kill the ghost the guide marks (level 19, hooded, no cape): it drops the orange Key.
do.s: First floor: kill the marked ghost (orange Key)

do.t: Open the orange door marked by the floor tile: east wall, second door from the north. Other orange doors use up the key. "The door is locked": no orange key, kill the marked ghost again.
do.s: First floor: the orange door with the floor tile

do.t: Climb the ladder behind the orange door up to the second floor.
do.s: Behind the orange door: ladder up

do.t: On the second floor, kill the skeleton the guide marks (level 22, small round shield): it drops the yellow Key.
do.s: Second floor: kill the marked skeleton (yellow Key)

do.t: Open the yellow door with the guide's floor tile: on the south wall, the one furthest west. The other yellow doors use up the key. "The door is locked" means you have no yellow Key: kill the marked skeleton again.
do.s: Second floor: the yellow door with the floor tile

do.t: Follow the corridor behind the yellow door to the ladder and climb down.
do.s: Behind the yellow door: ladder down

do.t: Climb down the next ladder, right where you land.
do.s: First floor: next ladder down

do.t: Climb down the ladder into the basement of Melzar's Maze.
do.s: Ground floor: ladder down to the basement

do.t: In the basement, kill the zombie the guide marks (level 24): it drops the blue Key. The brown door here leads out of the maze, not on.
do.s: Basement: kill the marked zombie (blue Key)

do.t: Open the blue door with the blue Key: there is only one.
do.s: Basement: the blue door

do.t: Kill Melzar the Mad (level 43) for the magenta key.
do.s: Basement: kill Melzar the Mad (magenta key)

do.t: Open the magenta (purple) door with the magenta Key.
do.s: Basement: the magenta door

do.t: Magic only: stand one square east of the magenta door, where the lesser demon cannot reach you. Cast Water Strike (Water Bolt from Magic 23) with metal armour off: it cuts magic accuracy to about a fifth.
do.s: Basement: kill the lesser demon (green key)

pre.t: No runes: leave the maze and buy Water, Air and Mind runes

do.t: Open the green door with the green Key.
do.s: Basement: the green door

do.t: Open the chest and take Melzar's map piece.
do.s: Basement: open the chest (map piece)

items.name: Maze key
items.where: From the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild (S5-01). He gives another if you lose it.

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food for the fights: up to a level 82 lesser demon.

items.name: Water rune
items.where: Water Strike for the lesser demon (magic only, from the safespot).

items.name: Air rune
items.where: Water Strike: 1 a cast.

items.name: Mind rune
items.where: Water Strike: 1 a cast.

route.title: The Oracle and the secret room
steps: Talk to the Oracle on top of Ice Mountain.
Go down the ladder in the dwarven camp, then use the four items on the magic door in the north-east of the Dwarven Mine.
Search the chest for Thalzar's map piece.

do.t: Talk to the Oracle on top of Ice Mountain. Dialogue: “I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.”.
do.s: Oracle (Ice Mountain): ask for the map piece

do.t: Go down the ladder in the dwarven camp south of Ice Mountain into the Dwarven Mine.
do.s: Dwarven camp: ladder down to the Dwarven Mine

do.t: Head to the square room in the north-east corner of the Dwarven Mine: the magic door is there. Use the Silk on the door.
do.s: Dwarven Mine: use Silk on the magic door

do.t: Use the lobster pot on the magic door.
do.s: Magic door: use the Lobster pot

do.t: Use the unfired bowl on the magic door.
do.s: Magic door: use the Unfired bowl

do.t: Use the wizard's mind bomb on the magic door. Be careful not to drink it.
do.s: Magic door: use the Wizard's mind bomb (do not drink it)

do.t: Search the chest for Thalzar's map piece.
do.s: Secret room: search the chest (map piece)

items.name: Silk
items.where: Silk trader in Al Kharid, 3 gp.

items.name: Lobster pot
items.where: Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim, 20 gp.

items.name: Unfired bowl
items.where: Soft clay on a pottery wheel (Crafting 8), or buy it on the Grand Exchange.

items.name: Wizard's mind bomb
items.where: Rising Sun Inn in Falador, 3 gp.

route.title: Wormbrain in Port Sarim Jail
steps: Pay Wormbrain 10,000 coins for Lozar's map piece in the dialogue.
Use the three Map parts on each other to make the Crandor map.

do.t: Go to Port Sarim Jail and pay Wormbrain 10,000 coins (Dialogue: “I believe you've got a piece of a map that I need.” → “I suppose I could pay you for the map piece...” → “Alright then, 10,000 it is.”).
do.s: Wormbrain (Port Sarim Jail): pay 10,000 gp

do.t: Use the three Map parts on each other to make the Crandor map.
do.s: Bag: use the three Map parts together (Crandor map)

items.name: Coins
items.where: Wormbrain takes exactly 10,000 coins.

route.title: The ship
steps: Buy Lady Lumbridge from Klarense on the south Port Sarim docks for 2,000 coins.
Board the ship, go down into the hull and repair the hole three times (a plank and 30 steel nails each).

do.t: Talk to Klarense on the south Port Sarim docks and buy his boat. Dialogue: “I'd like to buy her.” → “Yep, sounds good.”. It costs 2,000 coins.
do.s: Klarense (Port Sarim docks): buy Lady Lumbridge (2,000 gp)

do.t: Board your new ship by the gangplank.
do.s: Port Sarim docks: board Lady Lumbridge

do.t: Go down the ladder into the ship's hull.
do.s: Ship deck: ladder down to the hull

do.t: Use a Plank on the hole in the hull. Each plank takes 30 Steel nails, and a Hammer must be in the bag: 3 planks and 90 nails in all.
do.s: Hull: repair the hole, plank 1 of 3

do.t: Repair the hole again: second plank.
do.s: Hull: repair the hole, plank 2 of 3

do.t: Repair the hole a third time: last plank.
do.s: Hull: repair the hole, plank 3 of 3

items.name: Plank
items.where: Ordinary planks, bought on the Grand Exchange.

items.name: Steel nails
items.where: 30 for each plank: buy 90 on the Grand Exchange.

items.name: Hammer
items.where: Lumbridge General Store, 1 gp.

items.name: Coins
items.where: For the ship: 2,000 coins.

route.title: The map and the captain
steps: Use the three map pieces on each other to make the Crandor map.
Bring the map to Captain Ned in Draynor Village and ask him to be your captain.

do.t: Use the three Map parts on each other to make the Crandor map.
do.s: Bag: use the three Map parts together (Crandor map)

do.t: Bring Ned the Crandor map and ask him to be your captain. Dialogue: “You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?”.
do.s: Captain Ned (Draynor): ask him to be your captain

items.name: Map part
items.where: The three map pieces: Melzar's, Thalzar's and Lozar's (S5-03 to S5-05).

route.title: Sail to Crandor
steps: Do not board without the Anti-dragon shield, food and a strong weapon.
Board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim and talk to Ned on the deck.

route.title: Crandor and the volcano
steps: Go to the centre of the island and down the hole.
Go all the way south and through the wall: it unlocks the shortcut from the Karamja volcano.
Enter Elvarg's area and kill her. Her head ends up in your bag.

do.t: Prepare to fight Elvarg (level 83). Do not board without the Anti-dragon shield, plenty of food (lobsters or swordfish), a strong weapon (adamant or rune) and a strength potion. Then board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim.
do.s: Port Sarim: board the ship (Anti-dragon shield in the bag first!)

pre.t: Get the Anti-dragon shield from Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle
Take 20 or more lobsters or other good food: there is no bank on Crandor

do.t: Talk to Ned on the deck. Dialogue: “Yes, let's go!”.
do.s: Ship deck: talk to Ned to sail to Crandor

items.name: Anti-dragon shield
items.where: Worn before the fight: without it Elvarg's fire hits up to 70. Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle gives it free (S5-02).

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food: bring 20 or more (swordfish are as good).

items.name: Strength potion(4)
items.where: Optional boost: a strength potion before the fight.

do.t: Go to the centre of the island and go down the hole.
do.s: Crandor: climb down the hole in the centre of the island

do.t: Go all the way south and through the wall to unlock the shortcut to the Karamja volcano. Lesser demons (level 82) roam here: keep moving, eat when low. After a death, this is your way back.
do.s: Crandor dungeon: go south and through the wall (shortcut)

do.t: After a death before the shortcut was opened: board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim, repair the hole in the hull again (3 Planks, 90 Steel nails, a Hammer), then talk to Ned on deck to sail.
do.s: After a death: repair the hull again and sail with Ned

pre.t: Take 3 Planks: the hull needs repairing again
Take 90 Steel nails for the hull
Take a Hammer for the hull
Get the Anti-dragon shield from Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle
Take 20 or more lobsters or other good food: there is no bank on Crandor

do.t: After a death: re-equip (Anti-dragon shield worn, food, gear), sail from Port Sarim to Musa Point, walk west to the Karamja volcano and climb in. Your shortcut leads back to Crandor.
do.s: After a death: Karamja volcano (south of Brimhaven), climb in

pre.t: Wear the Anti-dragon shield before you go back to Elvarg
Take 20 or more lobsters or other good food: there is no bank on the way

do.t: In the volcano, go north through the wall you opened from the Crandor side, back into the Crandor dungeon.
do.s: Volcano: north through the wall shortcut back to Crandor

do.t: Equip the Anti-dragon shield, then climb into Elvarg's area. Pick the Stab style on the sword, eat below 20 health, and never take the shield off.
do.s: Crandor dungeon: enter Elvarg's lair (shield worn!)

do.t: Kill Elvarg (level 83) with the Anti-dragon shield worn. At low levels the wiki's safer way: flinch her from the south-east corner of her cave. Her head drops into your inventory.
do.s: Elvarg's lair: kill Elvarg (her head drops into the bag)

go.label: Crandor — the hole in the centre of the island

items.name: Anti-dragon shield
items.where: Worn: without it Elvarg's fire hits up to 70.

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food: 20 or more.

route.title: Finish
steps: Talk to Oziach in north-western Edgeville to finish the quest.

do.t: Talk to Oziach in his hut in north-western Edgeville to finish the quest. Then you can buy and wear the Rune platebody (Defence 40).
do.s: Oziach (Edgeville): finish the quest
